name: dsh-upload-files
description: Web sidebar file upload for the DeepSeek Harness: an upload icon in the workspace section header (next to search / view-options / add-workspace) stores files in a dedicated ~/.dsh/uploads directory with persistent history, and exposes a list_uploads tool so agents can query uploaded files by path and process them per user instructions. / DSH Web 侧边栏文件上传：工作区标题行（搜索/视图/新建图标旁）的上传入口，文件存入专用目录 ~/.dsh/uploads 并保留历史记录；agent 通过 list_uploads 工具查询上传历史并按用户指令处理对应文件。
